name: Market Vendor
background: A merchant in the Court of the Gentiles. He sees everyone and hears everything — useful for gathering rumors.

genericReactions.physical: Interesting. Is it for sale? No? Well, can I interest you in some figs?
genericReactions.testimonial: I hear many things at my stall. The whole city is buzzing.
genericReactions.digital: I don't read the official notices. I listen to the street.
genericReactions.environmental: My stall is right here in the thick of it. I see everything.
genericReactions.analytical: Lots of talk, lots of people. Good for business, mostly.
genericReactions.prophecy: They say he's a prophet. It's the talk of the market.
